depth_findings.text: The new tests cover the bracket, the ledger and the generation stamping only; there is no test that summarize_head emits abort or commit on a timeout or a provider error, because it needs a live AppState (source-read or mock-state test needed).

The ledger is per replica and keyed (thread, generation). Two concurrent turns on one thread share a generation (0 on the message-count path), so one begin can overwrite the other's entry. The unmatched report is advisory only (WS04 multi-replica).

The head_summary key literal is now duplicated in compaction.rs and session_flow.rs. Fold generation into StoredHeadSummary and with_head_summary when session_flow.rs is next open, and delete stamp_generation.
Durable commit and abort records, and a durable reader for the generation, are WS17. The compaction_generation written now is also not read by the non-budget message-count path.
The metric on /metrics and the abort outcome under a forced summariser timeout still need a rebuilt model-gateway and a live capture.
No test shows that summarize_head commits on a usable answer, or aborts with timeout, provider_error or empty_summary. It needs a live AppState or a source-reading test.

The unmatched sweep runs only inside CompactionTx::begin on that replica. With no further compaction after a dropped stream, a stale entry stays in the ledger and is never counted. It is also keyed (thread, generation), and the message-count path always uses generation 0, so two concurrent turns on one thread overwrite each other's entry. Both are advisory limits, deferred to WS04 and WS17.

The head_summary key literal and the record writing now sit in both compaction.rs (stamp_generation) and session_flow.rs. Fold compaction_generation into StoredHeadSummary and with_head_summary when session_flow.rs is next open, then delete stamp_generation.

compaction_generation is written on every turn that persists a head_summary, but only the token-budget path reads it back. The message-count path persists nothing and passes 0. A durable commit/abort record and a durable generation reader are WS17.

The last hunk of the run_infer_fallback metadata block in sse.rs has a closing parenthesis indented off by one level, which rustfmt would change. `cargo fmt --check` already reports hundreds of unrelated diffs in sse.rs, so this adds noise only.

An empty summarizer answer aborts the bracket but still returns Some("") to apply_head_summary, as before. The prompt falls back to the dropped-history notice the same way, and plan.record rejects empty summaries, so nothing is persisted. Behaviour is unchanged; the abort is metrics-only.
mp_gateway_compaction_total on /metrics and the abort/timeout outcome under a forced summariser timeout still need a rebuilt model-gateway and a live capture.

results.notes:
The code is built and compiles. The tests are written but have not been seen to pass, so the slice is partial.

Built in compaction.rs (CRLF kept):
- CompactionTx with begin, commit(summary_digest) and abort(CompactionAbort). The abort reasons are timeout, provider_error and empty_summary. A second close is refused (commit after abort gives AlreadyAborted; abort after commit gives AlreadyCommitted).
- CompactionLedger, an in-process map keyed (thread, generation). take_unmatched removes and returns entries begun more than COMPACTION_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT ago that never closed. Every begin sweeps it, counts each stale entry as phase=begin, outcome=unmatched and logs a warning.
- The counter mp_gateway_compaction_total{phase,outcome} is emitted through metrics::counter!. Outcomes are started, unmatched, ok, the abort reasons and refused.
- COMPACTION_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT (6 s) moved here from sse.rs.
- summary_digest: the first 32 hex characters of blake3 over the trimmed summary. No content is logged or put in a metric label.
- NewHeadSummary { record: StoredHeadSummary, generation }, stamp_generation(metadata, new) and persisted_generation(metadata). The generation is written as compaction_generation inside the existing head_summary metadata struct. Records without one read as 0.
- Tests added: a_begun_but_never_committed_compaction_is_reported_unmatched, commit_after_abort_is_refused, abort_after_commit_is_refused, a_summary_digest_names_the_text_without_carrying_it, the_generation_rides_inside_the_head_summary_record.

Changed in sse.rs (LF kept):
- summarize_head takes a generation. It begins the bracket right before the bounded direct_infer call, after the memory-directive read, so the bracket times exactly the 6 s call. A timeout, provider error or empty answer aborts; a usable answer commits. The returned Option<String> is the same as before, so the existing DROPPED_HISTORY_NOTICE fallback in apply_head_summary is unchanged and the prompt bytes are identical.
- The message-count caller passes generation 0, because nothing is persisted on that path.
- The token-budget caller passes persisted_generation + 1. The persisted generation is read from the newest assistant message that carries a head_summary record.
- RecentThread.head_summary and the fallback function's parameter are now NewHeadSummary.
- The two metadata-writing sites (the direct-answer path and the run_infer_fallback path) wrap with_head_summary in stamp_generation.

There is no new switch. Behaviour is unchanged apart from the new counter and the extra compaction_generation key inside head_summary metadata. The key is not written under ZDR, because with_head_summary already withholds the record.

The generation lives next to StoredHeadSummary (as NewHeadSummary) and not inside it. session_flow.rs, which I do not own, builds StoredHeadSummary with full literals, so adding a field there would not compile.
